create.name: Iyengar Yoga Centre of Victoria
create.bio:
The Iyengar Yoga Centre of Victoria is a non-profit society that has taught the Iyengar method in Greater Victoria since 1978, when Shirley Daventry French and her husband Derek set it up to bring visiting teachers to the city. Classes began at the local YM-YWCA, B.K.S. Iyengar himself visited in 1984, and several of the centre's founding teachers, including Leslie Hogya, Marlene Miller and Shirley Daventry French herself, were in the first group of Canadians authorised to assess and certify Iyengar teachers in the 1990s. Today it has its own studio on Fort Street in downtown Victoria, with hardwood floors, rope walls and a full stock of props.

A team of around fifteen certified and apprentice teachers runs term-based classes from an introductory level through Levels 1 to 4, along with pranayama, restorative sessions and classes for students over 55. Free introductory classes welcome complete newcomers, and every class and workshop can be paid for on a pay-what-you-can basis. Members can use the studio for their own practice on Sunday afternoons. Weekend workshops, teacher intensives and online sessions with senior guests from India and North America run through the year, and the centre publishes newsletters and practice articles on its site.

courses.title: Term classes: Intro to Level 4, Pranayama, Restorative and 55+
courses.description: Term-based weekly classes graded from a beginning level through Levels 1 to 4, with a pranayama series for students who have practised postures for at least six months, restorative sessions and classes for older students. Missed classes can be made up in any term.

courses.title: Drop-in classes and Pay What You Can
courses.description: Single drop-in rates priced by class length, with term registration as the alternative. The centre also invites students to pay what they can for any class or workshop.
courses.price: 1 hour classes – $18; 1.25 hour – $20; 1.5 hour – $25.50; 2 hours – $31 (add GST)

courses.title: Centre membership
courses.description: Annual membership of the non-profit society, which supports the centre and gives free use of the studio for personal practice on Sunday afternoons, as well as a voice in how the society is run.

courses.title: Strength Stamina Stability Workshop IN STUDIO
courses.description: A two-hour Saturday morning workshop for all levels with Marlene Miller, one of the centre's longest-serving teachers. It works on building steadiness and endurance in the postures.

free_resources.title: An Independent Pranayama Practice
free_resources.description: An article by one of the centre's teachers describing how a home pranayama practice can be set up and carried through, following on from easing breath work into posture practice.
